resources.string: The first three cards need no SDK call at all — wrapping the navigation tree in ConnectWrapper is what captures them.
Every navigation inside ConnectWrapper logs a screen view. The name is the destination\'s route, and the referrer is the screen you came from.

Every touch inside ConnectWrapper is logged as a tap event. Nothing to call — tap the button and look for the tap in the next post. The button also appears in the captured layout as its own control, under a readable id built from its text.

Each LoggedOutlinedTextField is captured in the screen\'s layout as its own control. A field whose label is listed in MaskAccessibilityLabelList in ConnectLayoutConfig.json is masked before the layout leaves the device.
The sample config lists the second field\'s label, Masked field, in MaskAccessibilityLabelList. Compare the two fields\' entries in the posted layout message.
